name: Paired lancet window
parts: two pointed lancet openings sharing a central stone mullion
roll-moulded limestone jamb and arch surrounds
hood mould with carved label stops
diamond-quarry leaded glass in lead cames
coursed limestone ashlar blocks with mortar joints
chamfered stone sill with throated drip
sooted weathering on the upper sill
summary: Paired Gothic Revival lancet windows: two pointed limestone openings under one hood mould, with leaded glass, iron saddle bars and a shared drip sill.
